Mixed purées

Cauliflower and broccoli with cheese

Karfiol és brokkoli sajttal

6 months+ Sound idea 25 min 4 portions

The cheese version contains milk. The olive oil version does not. Keep the cheese to 30 g across 4 portions.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 180 g broccoli (florets, tough stalk peeled if you use it)
  • 180 g cauliflower (florets)
  • 30 g pasteurised mild full-fat cheese (modest amount; skip it for the milk-free path)
  • 2 tsp olive oil (use this instead of cheese if you want the dish milk-free)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Cut the broccoli and cauliflower into small florets.
  2. Steam or boil in unsalted water until very soft.
  3. Blend with a spoon of cooking water until smooth.
  4. Stir in the grated cheese while the purée is warm, and blend again.
  5. For a milk-free bowl, skip the cheese and stir in the olive oil instead.
  6. Do not add salt, and do not increase the cheese.

Sound idea

Cheese is salty if the amount is more than modest. A baby who needs a milk-free plate cannot eat the cheese version.

Blend broccoli and cauliflower with a little pasteurised cheese, or with olive oil if you want it milk-free. Keep the cheese modest, and no other change is needed.
